label: rare, diffuse: consonant input (d/w/j/r/p/l) after an a, or orig(0) re-input after <DEL>
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.03% of steps, weak magnitudes 0.1-0.24). Enrichments: input tokens d,w,j,r,p,l (d 6.9x); previous token a (11x) or two-back a/z; positions t=2-3 in the original phase and the first copy step after <DEL> (recall_idx 1, input = orig(0), often first_tok a/w/o/z); also the last copy steps of L=9 sequences. No conjunction reached useful precision: best F1 was about 0.04 (prev_tok a & consonant input, original phase; precision 0.02, recall 0.28). A broad predicate (consonant input after any of a/z/c/o seen) covers 84% of mass at 0.2% precision. Activation seems to depend on a specific hidden-state combination that the per-step variables do not capture. Magnitude is not explained by any variable checked. Almost never fires at t=0-1 or at copy steps recall_idx 2-3.
